fields.Institution: Galgotias Institute of Management and Technology
fields.Affiliation / University: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University
fields.Intake — Published:
180 for MBA at GIMT; a separate MBA Logistics & Supply Chain Management intake of 60 is listed by the group
Published numeric intake: 180
fields.Fees — Published: ₹1,09,603 annual tuition. First-year payment ₹1,15,603 includes ₹5,000 refundable security and ₹1,000 application. AKTU exam/enrolment ₹7,500 is paid separately when demanded.
fields.Fee Scope: Published 2026–27 annual/first-year schedule. Two-year tuition and ancillary totals are conditional calculations if annual rates remain unchanged.
fields.Eligibility: Bachelor's degree with at least 50% (45% SC/ST)
fields.Selection Process: AKTU counselling through CUET-PG; management/vacant seats filled first from qualified candidates then graduation merit as permitted
fields.Placement — Published:
158 of 159 graduates placed 2023–24; 1 higher studies(NIRF 2025)
Published/calculated rate %: 99.37
fields.Placement Scope: GIMT Management PG two-year cohort, 2023–24: median ₹5.8 lakh, 158 of 159 placed. No mean disclosed.
fields.Top Recruiters: Official group placement FAQ names MBA recruiters Deloitte, KPMG, EY, PwC, S&P Global, Axis Bank, Capgemini, Airtel, Tata Consumer, Wipro, Flipkart, Amazon, Indigo and Zepto. Group MBA recruiter network; annual GIMT-specific counts not given.
